entries.content: AP conventions for Brightside Fixtures: owner approval cap is $2,500.00 (250000 cents) per bill - anything at or above needs explicit owner sign-off before approval. Grounds care and the IT retainer run on bill schedules; the IT retainer contract ended 2026-07-31 and renewals are hand-keyed until the new contract is signed. Pay runs happen Fridays.
